cases.prompt: Plant Alpha wants the machine alert use case on a hydraulic press that is not connected to anything yet. Controller is a Siemens type, data should go to the plant platform. What do we order?
cases.expected_output:
Collects machine facts (controller vendor and model, protocol, program version, data landing place).
Looks up the route in the validated routes and states its status with source.
Writes a system match record; kit price and lead time are marked missing unless in the kit list.
Names the next step (1b order and connect) and the Cyber Security status as open.

cases.prompt: A plant has a 20 year old machine with a proprietary serial protocol and wants an andon board on it. Which standard kit can they just order?
cases.expected_output:
States that there is no standardized system when the route is TODO, stub or absent.
Does not invent a kit, price or lead time.
Hands to invest-screen and Lane 3 (3b) as next step.
Still fills the record with fields marked missing.

cases.prompt: The plant asks for a simple dashboard that also prints labels and tracks batch genealogy for each order. Which of our standard tools covers it?
cases.expected_output:
Flags order execution, labels and batch genealogy as execution-system territory, not a dashboard.
Maps the requested functions before choosing a tool and names the overlap with MES.
Does not recommend a tool without a defined use case behind it.

cases.prompt: A plant says they need to reduce downtime but do not know which use case fits. Which catalogued use case should they pick?
cases.expected_output:
Recognizes this as choosing the use case, which belongs to catalog-usecase.
Does not start a system match.
